usage: have/has been + V-ing。表从过去持续到现在的动作，强调过程。
examples: I've been waiting for an hour.
She has been studying all morning.
How long have you been working here?
mistakes: has been 后接过去分词
has been 与 has gone 混淆
compare: 现在完成进行时 vs. 现在完成时：过程 vs. 结果。

usage: had + 过去分词。表过去某一时间之前发生的动作。
examples: When I arrived, she had already left.
I had never seen such a beautiful place.
He had finished before I came.
mistakes: 过去完成时与过去式顺序颠倒
had 后接过去式
compare: 过去完成时 = 过去的过去。

usage: had been + V-ing。表过去某时之前一直持续的动作。
examples: I had been working for two hours when he called.
She was tired because she had been running.
They had been living there for years.
mistakes: had been 后接过去分词
had been 与 was/were 混用
compare: 过去完成进行时强调持续到过去某时的过程。

usage: will be + V-ing。表将来某时正在进行的动作。
examples: This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to Paris.
At 8 p.m., we'll be having dinner.
Will you be working tomorrow?
mistakes: will be 后接过去分词
将来进行时与 be going to 混用
compare: 将来进行时表将来某时的背景动作。

usage: will have + 过去分词。表将来某时之前完成的动作。
examples: By next year, I'll have graduated.
She will have finished by 6 p.m.
They will have left by the time we arrive.
mistakes: 将来完成时与将来时混用
will have 后接动词原形
compare: by + 将来时间 → will have done。

usage: will have been + V-ing。表到将来某时一直持续的动作。
examples: By July, I'll have been working here for ten years.
She will have been studying for six hours.
mistakes: will have been 后接过去分词
与将来完成时混淆
compare: 将来完成进行时强调持续到将来某时的过程。

usage: 第二/第三条件句混合，if 从句与主句时间不同。
examples: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now. (过去→现在)
If I were rich, I would have bought a house. (现在→过去)
mistakes: if 从句与主句时态不匹配
would have 后接现在式
compare: 混合条件句需根据时间选择对应时态。

usage: If + had + 过去分词, would have + 过去分词。表过去不可能。
examples: If I had known, I would have told you.
She would have passed if she had studied.
If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
mistakes: if 从句用 would have
主句用 had + 过去分词
compare: 第三条件句：与过去事实相反。

grammar: Modal verbs of deduction: must, can't, might, may
usage: must 肯定推测；can't 否定推测；might/may 可能。
examples: He must be tired.
It can't be true.
She might be at home.
mistakes: must 的否定用 mustn't（应为 can't）
might 与 must 程度混淆
compare: must > may > might > can't（肯定→否定）。

grammar: Modal verbs of obligation: must, should, ought to, have to
usage: must 强烈主观；have to 客观；should/ought to 建议。
examples: You must finish this today.
You should apologise.
You ought to see a doctor.
mistakes: ought to 后接 to 忘记
should 与 must 语气不分
compare: ought to = should，语气稍强。

grammar: Modal verbs of permission: can, could, may, might
usage: can 日常许可；could/may 更礼貌；might 最委婉/不确定。
examples: Can I use your phone?
May I come in?
Could I borrow this book?
mistakes: May 后接动词原形错误
can 与 may 在请求中完全等同
compare: may 更正式；could 更礼貌。

grammar: Modal verbs of ability: can, could, be able to, manage to
usage: can 现在能力；could 过去能力；be able to 可用于各种时态；manage to 表成功做到。
examples: I can swim.
I was able to finish on time.
She managed to escape.
mistakes: could 表过去具体能力时常用 was able to
managed to 与 could 混用
compare: managed to 强调经过努力成功。

grammar: Modal verbs of advice: should, ought to, had better
usage: should/ought to 建议；had better 警告/强烈建议（不做会有后果）。
examples: You should take a break.
You'd better not be late.
You ought to see a dentist.
mistakes: had better 后接 to
had better 与 should 语气不分
compare: had better 不做有负面后果。

usage: must, need, should, could 等在间接引语中常变化。
examples: 'You must leave,' he said. → He said (that) I had to leave.
'You can go,' she said. → She said (that) I could go.
'I will help,' he said. → He said (that) he would help.
mistakes: must 在间接引语中仍用 must（可能变化）
will 不变 would
compare: must 若表必须，间接引语常用 had to；表推测时可用 must。

usage: 所有时态都有被动形式：is done, was done, has been done, will be done。
examples: The project is being discussed now.
The report has been finished.
The meeting will be held tomorrow.
mistakes: 被动语态中漏掉 be 或过去分词
进行时被动语态结构错误
compare: 被动语态：be + 过去分词，be 体现时态。

usage: give/show/tell/send 等可有两个宾语，均可变被动。
examples: She gave me a book. → I was given a book. / A book was given to me.
They showed us the way. → We were shown the way.
mistakes: 双宾语被动漏 to/for
主动间接宾语与直接宾语位置错
compare: give sb sth = give sth to sb。

usage: It is said/believed/known that... / He is said to...
examples: It is said that he is rich.
He is said to be rich.
It is believed that she left.
mistakes: He is said to be 后接动词原形（应为 to be/完成式）
It is said 后接 that 漏掉
compare: sb is said to be/do/have done。

usage: have/get + 宾语 + 过去分词；get 比 have 更口语。
examples: I got my hair cut.
He had his car stolen.
We need to get this fixed.
mistakes: have/get 后接 doing 表被动
have 与 make 使役混淆
compare: make sb do sth 不带 to；have/get sth done。

usage: 用逗号隔开，提供额外信息，不可用 that。
examples: My mother, who is 60, lives in Paris.
The Eiffel Tower, which is in Paris, is famous.
Tom, whose brother is a doctor, arrived late.
mistakes: 非限定从句用 that
漏掉逗号
compare: 非限定从句中关系代词不能省略。

usage: whose 表所属，可指人也可指物。
examples: The man whose car was stolen is here.
I met a woman whose son is a doctor.
The house whose roof is red is mine.
mistakes: whose 与 who's 混淆
whose 只能指人
compare: whose = of which/whom。

meaning: where / when / why 定语从句
usage: where 地点，when 时间，why 原因。
examples: This is the town where I was born.
Do you remember the day when we met?
That's the reason why I left.
mistakes: where 前加 in/at（多余）
why 前加 for（多余）
compare: the reason why 中 why 可省略。

usage: 用现在分词或过去分词短语简化定语从句。
examples: The man sitting next to me is a doctor. (= who is sitting)
The book written by her is popular. (= which was written)
People living in cities are busy.
mistakes: 简化后保留关系代词
过去分词与现在分词混淆
compare: 主动关系用 doing，被动关系用 done。

usage: 现在分词/过去分词短语作状语，表时间、原因、条件等。
examples: Walking home, I saw an accident. (时间/原因)
Seen from above, the city looks small. (条件)
Feeling tired, she went to bed. (原因)
mistakes: 分词短语主语与主句主语不一致
分词短语后接完整句子
compare: 分词短语逻辑主语需与主句主语一致。

meaning: 动名词 vs. 不定式（动词后）
usage: stop, remember, forget, try, regret, mean, go on 等后接 doing/to do 意义不同。
examples: I stopped smoking. (停止做)
I stopped to smoke. (停下来去做)
I remember meeting him. (记得做过)
I remembered to meet him. (记得要去做)
mistakes: stop 后接 to do 与 doing 意义混淆
remember 后接 to do 与 doing 混淆
compare: remember doing 记得做过；remember to do 记得去做。

meaning: 动名词 vs. 不定式（主语）
usage: Doing sth 作主语更常见；To do sth 作主语表具体/目的。
examples: Swimming is good for your health.
To finish on time is important.
It is important to finish on time. (更自然)
mistakes: 动词原形作主语
不定式主语用 it 作形式主语时结构错
compare: It's + adj + to do 是更自然结构。

grammar: Verb patterns: want / would like / need / enjoy / refuse
usage: want to do, would like to do, need to do, enjoy doing, refuse to do。
examples: I want to go.
She enjoys reading.
He refused to help.
mistakes: enjoy 后接 to do
want 后接 doing
compare: 固定搭配需记忆。

usage: make/let + 宾语 + 动词原形；help + 宾语 + (to) do。
examples: She made me laugh.
Let me help you.
He helped me (to) carry the box.
mistakes: make 后接 to do
let 后接 to do
compare: make/let 后接不带 to 的不定式。

usage: suggest/recommend + doing；advise + sb + to do。
examples: I suggest leaving early.
I recommend trying this.
She advised me to see a doctor.
mistakes: suggest 后接 to do
recommend 后接 to do
compare: suggest that + 主语 + (should) do。

usage: It is important/necessary/strange that + (should) + 动词。
examples: It is important that you be on time. (美)
It is strange that he should say that.
It is necessary that she come early.
mistakes: should 省略时误以为语法错误
that 从句用 should 时误用 would
compare: 虚拟语气中 should 可省略。

usage: wish, if only, as if, would rather, it's time 后的非真实形式。
examples: I wish I were rich.
It's time we left.
He acts as if he knew everything.
mistakes: wish 后接 will
as if 后接 will
compare: 虚拟语气中 be 常用 were。

usage: would rather + 动词原形；would rather + 从句用过去式。
examples: I'd rather stay home.
I'd rather you didn't smoke here.
I'd sooner walk than drive.
mistakes: would rather 后接 to do
would rather 从句中用现在时
compare: would rather 从句用过去式表虚拟。

usage: It's time (for sb) to do；It's time + 从句用过去式。
examples: It's time to go.
It's time for bed.
It's time you went to bed.
mistakes: It's time 从句用现在时
It's time 后接 for 与 to 混淆
compare: It's time + 从句用过去式表虚拟。

usage: 表好像，后接过去式或过去完成式表虚拟。
examples: He behaves as if he were the boss.
It looks as if it's going to rain.
She talks as though she knew everything.
mistakes: as if 后接 will
as if 与 like 混淆
compare: as if 后可接真实或虚拟语气。

usage: Never, rarely, seldom, hardly, scarcely, no sooner 放句首时部分倒装。
examples: Never have I seen such a thing.
Hardly had we arrived when it started to rain.
No sooner had I left than the phone rang.
mistakes: 倒装时主语与助动词位置未换
no sooner 后接 than 与 when 混淆
compare: hardly...when；no sooner...than。

usage: So + adj/adv + that... 放句首时部分倒装。
examples: So beautiful was the view that we stayed for hours.
Such was the weather that we stayed indoors.
So quickly did he run that I couldn't catch him.
mistakes: so 引导倒装时主语位置错误
such 后接名词时倒装错误
compare: So + adj/adv + 助动词 + 主语 + that。

usage: 避免重复，省略主语、助动词、动词或名词。
examples: I like coffee, but she doesn't. (省略 like coffee)
Are you coming? Yes, I am. (省略 coming)
He can swim, but I can't.
mistakes: 省略后句子结构不完整
doesn't 后省略内容错误
compare: 省略需保持语法完整。

usage: do/does 替代动词；so 替代从句；one 替代名词。
examples: I think so.
I hope so.
I prefer the red one.
mistakes: I think so 与 I think it 混淆
do 替代 be 动词
compare: I think so / I hope so / I'm afraid so。

usage: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子其余。
examples: It was John who broke the window.
It was yesterday that I saw her.
It is in Paris that she lives.
mistakes: 强调句中漏 that/who
强调句中时态不一致
compare: 强调句去掉 It is...that 后句子仍完整。

usage: What + 主语 + 动词，整体作主语/宾语。
examples: What I need is a break.
What she said surprised me.
What happened next was shocking.
mistakes: what 引导从句中再缺主语/宾语
what 与 that 引导从句混淆
compare: what 在从句中充当成分，that 不充当。

grammar: Clauses of reason: because, since, as, for
usage: because 直接原因；since/as 已知原因；for 书面补充说明。
examples: Because it rained, we stayed home.
Since you're busy, I'll leave.
As it was late, we went home.
mistakes: because 与 for 混用
because 与 because of 混用
compare: because + 句子；because of + noun/gerund。

usage: so + adj/adv + that；such + a/an + adj + noun + that。
examples: It was so hot that we stayed inside.
She is such a good teacher that everyone loves her.
He ran so fast that I couldn't catch him.
mistakes: so 与 such 结构混淆
so 后接名词
compare: so + adj/adv；such + noun phrase。

grammar: Clauses of purpose: to / so that / in order to
usage: to/in order to + 动词；so that/in order that + 从句。
examples: I went to bed early to get up at 6.
He spoke slowly so that everyone could hear.
In order to pass, she studied hard.
mistakes: so that 从句中用 will（应为 could/can）
in order to 后接 -ing
compare: so that 从句常用 can/could/will/would。

usage: although/even though 不与 but 连用；while 可表对比或让步。
examples: Although he is young, he is wise.
Even though it was raining, we went out.
While I understand, I disagree.
mistakes: although 与 but 同句
while 表时间 vs. 让步混淆
compare: although 不能与 but 连用，但可与 yet/still 连用。

grammar: Clauses of condition: provided / as long as
usage: provided (that), as long as, unless 引导条件从句。
examples: I'll come provided you cook dinner.
As long as you try, you'll succeed.
You can go unless you finish your work.
mistakes: provided 后接 will
as long as 与 if 完全等同
compare: provided/as long as 强调条件。

grammar: Clauses of time: by the time / the moment
usage: by the time, the moment, as soon as, immediately 引导时间从句。
examples: The moment I saw her, I knew.
By the time you read this, I'll be gone.
Call me as soon as you arrive.
mistakes: the moment 后接 will
by the time 从句时态错误
compare: the moment/immediately 引导从句用一般现在时表将来。

grammar: Clauses of manner: as / as if / like
usage: as 表正如；as if 表好像；like 口语中表好像。
examples: Do as I say.
He acts as if he knows everything.
She sings like an angel.
mistakes: as if 与 like 在正式文体中混用
as 与 like 完全等同
compare: 正式写作中 as if 比 like 更被接受。

grammar: Noun clauses with that / if / whether
usage: that 引导陈述；if/whether 引导是否。
examples: I know that he is right.
I wonder if she will come.
I don't know whether to stay or go.
mistakes: whether 与 if 后接不定式时只能用 whether
that 从句中再加疑问语序
compare: whether...or not；whether + to do。

meaning: 疑问词引导名词性从句
usage: what/where/when/why/how 引导名词性从句，用陈述语序。
examples: I don't know what he wants.
Tell me where you live.
I wonder how she did it.
mistakes: 名词性从句用疑问语序
what 与 that 引导从句混淆
compare: 疑问词在名词性从句中不引起倒装。

usage: too + adj + to do；adj + enough + to do；so + adj + that。
examples: It's too cold to go out.
He isn't old enough to drive.
It's so cold that we stayed in.
mistakes: enough 位置错误
too 与 so 结构混淆
compare: too...to 表太……而不能。

usage: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句。
examples: He was so tired that he fell asleep.
She speaks so quickly that I can't follow.
The book was so interesting that I read it in one day.
mistakes: so 后接名词
that 从句中仍用 so
compare: so 强调形容词/副词，such 强调名词短语。

usage: such + a/an + adj + 单数名词 + that；such + adj + 复数/不可数名词 + that。
examples: It was such a beautiful day that we went out.
They are such good students that everyone likes them.
It was such bad weather that we stayed home.
mistakes: such 后接 adj 时漏 a/an
such 与 so 结构混淆
compare: such + (a/an) + adj + noun + that。

usage: enough + 名词（足够多）；形容词/副词 + enough（足够……）。
examples: We have enough time.
He is old enough to vote.
She runs fast enough.
mistakes: enough 放在形容词前
enough 修饰名词时放在名词后
compare: enough 修饰名词可前置，修饰形容词/副词必须后置。

usage: 频率副词在 be 后/动词前；方式副词在句末；评论副词在句首。
examples: She always arrives on time.
He speaks English fluently.
Fortunately, no one was hurt.
mistakes: 频率副词放在句末（口语可）
方式副词放在动词与宾语之间
compare: He speaks English fluently. 不能放 He speaks fluently English.

usage: 可分短语动词：名词可放中间或后面，代词必须放中间。
examples: Turn off the light. / Turn the light off. / Turn it off.
Pick up your clothes. / Pick them up.
mistakes: 代词放短语动词后（*pick up it*）
名词只能放后面（错误）
compare: pick it up, turn it off, put them on。

usage: 间接疑问句用陈述语序，助动词 do 不出现。
examples: Do you know where he lives?
I wonder what she wants.
Can you tell me how old she is?
mistakes: 间接疑问句用疑问语序
间接疑问句保留 do
compare: where does he live? → where he lives。

usage: a/an 表泛指或首次；the 表特指或独一无二；零冠词用于抽象、泛复数、专有名词。
examples: Life is difficult. (零冠词)
The life of a sailor is hard. (特指)
I love music. (零冠词)
mistakes: 抽象名词前加 the
专有名词前加 the（特例除外）
compare: 乐器前加 the：play the piano。

usage: most countries/states/cities/towns/lakes 无 the；rivers/oceans/seas/mountain ranges 有 the。
examples: the United States, the Alps, the Pacific Ocean
France, Tokyo, Lake Victoria
the River Thames
mistakes: the + 国家名（多数国家不加）
the + 湖泊名（多数不加）
compare: the + 复数国名/河流/海洋/山脉。

usage: go to school（上学）/go to the school（去学校）意义不同。
examples: He went to hospital. (住院)
He went to the hospital. (去医院办事)
She is in bed. (睡觉)
mistakes: the 与零冠词意义不分
所有建筑前都加 the
compare: 零冠词常表抽象功能。

usage: many/few/a few + 可数；much/little/a little + 不可数；a lot of/lots of/plenty of 两者皆可。
examples: Many students passed.
Much time was wasted.
Plenty of food was left.
mistakes: much 用于肯定句（通常用 a lot of）
many 修饰不可数
compare: a lot of 最通用，much/many 多见于否定/疑问。

usage: all 全部，both 两者，neither 两者都不，either 任一，none 全无。
examples: All of the students passed.
Neither answer is correct.
None of them came.
mistakes: none 后接单数还是复数动词
neither 与 none 范围混淆
compare: none of + 复数名词可用单数或复数动词。

usage: each 强调个体，every 强调整体，all 表全部。
examples: Each child received a gift.
Every child received a gift.
All children received gifts.
mistakes: each 与 every 后接复数动词
all 与 every 混用
compare: each/every + 单数动词；all + 复数动词。

usage: another 另一个；other 其他的；the other 特定另一个；others 其他人/物。
examples: I need another pen.
Other people may disagree.
Some like tea, others prefer coffee.
mistakes: another 与 other 混用
others 与 the others 范围混淆
compare: another + 单数；other + 复数。

usage: one/ones 替代名词避免重复；some 替代复数名词。
examples: I prefer the blue one.
I couldn't find any good ones.
Some of my friends are doctors.
mistakes: one 替代不可数名词
some 替代单数名词
compare: one 代替单数可数名词；some 代替复数或不可数。

grammar: So do I / Neither do I / I do too
usage: So + 助动词 + 主语；Neither + 助动词 + 主语；I do too / I don't either。
examples: I love music. So do I.
I don't like spinach. Neither do I.
I like it. I do too.
mistakes: so/neither 后接主语位置错误
I do too 用于否定句
compare: I do too 用于肯定；I don't either 用于否定。

usage: 正式文体避免缩写、俚语，多用被动、名词化；非正式可随意。
examples: Formal: I would appreciate it if you could...
Informal: Can you...?
Formal: We regret to inform you that...
mistakes: 正式邮件用俚语
非正式场合用过于正式表达
compare: 正式文体常用 shall, whom, whereas。

usage: 不同文体用词、句式、称呼不同。
examples: Dear Sir/Madam, ... Yours faithfully...
Hi ..., ... Best regards...
In conclusion, ... On the one hand... On the other hand...
mistakes: 正式信结尾用 Cheers
作文用口语缩写
compare: Yours faithfully（未知姓名）；Yours sincerely（已知姓名）。

usage: because (of), due to, owing to, as a result, consequently, therefore, thus, hence。
examples: Due to the rain, the match was cancelled.
Consequently, we arrived late.
The flight was cancelled because of bad weather.
mistakes: due to 后接句子（应为名词）
because 与 because of 混淆
compare: due to/owing to + noun；because + 句子。

usage: however, on the other hand, in contrast, whereas, while, although, even though, despite, in spite of。
examples: While some people agree, others don't.
In spite of the rain, we went out.
On the other hand, it could be expensive.
mistakes: despite 后接句子（应为名词/动名词）
although 与 despite 同句
compare: despite/in spite of + noun/gerund。

usage: furthermore, moreover, in addition, besides, firstly, secondly, finally。
examples: Firstly, we need to plan. Secondly, we need to execute. Finally, we review.
Moreover, the cost is high.
Besides, I don't have time.
mistakes: firstly 与 at first 混淆
furthermore 与 however 混淆
compare: firstly/secondly/finally 用于列举。

usage: introduction-body-conclusion；topic sentence, supporting sentences, concluding sentence。
examples: In this essay, I will discuss...
On the one hand... On the other hand...
In conclusion, ...
mistakes: 缺少主题句
段落之间无过渡
compare: 一个段落一个中心思想。

usage: 上升：rise, increase, go up；下降：fall, decrease, go down；稳定：remain stable。
examples: Sales increased sharply in 2020.
Prices remained stable.
There was a dramatic fall in unemployment.
mistakes: trend 与 tendency 混用
形容词与副词在描述趋势中混淆
compare: increased sharply（动词+副词）；a sharp increase（形容词+名词）。
